children: BCB Bancorp entered into an Underwriting Agreement to support a public offering of common stock and bolster capital. The company sold 11,000,000 shares, and the underwriter exercised the full 1,650,000-share overallotment, resulting in aggregate net proceeds of approximately $92.4 million after fees and expenses. The agreement includes customary representations and indemnification provisions.
